The figure is a trend chart of changes in the proportions of employed persons engaged in industries in China from 2000 to 2009, published in the white paper The Human Resources Situation in China. <image1> According to the trend shown in the figure, how will the proportion of employed persons in China's primary industry change in the future?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a line chart of changes in the employment proportions of China's three industries from 2000 to 2009, with the vertical axis as percentage and the horizontal axis as years. The legend shows that the line corresponding to “proportion of employed persons in the primary industry” is about 50% around 2000, then generally moves downward, and by 2009 has fallen to about 40%, showing an obvious downward trend. Then reason: The question asks to judge the future change according to the trend shown in the figure, so by simply extrapolating the downward trend from 2000 to 2009, it can be judged that the proportion of employed persons in China's primary industry will continue to decrease in the future.

raw_record.question_text:
The State Council Information Office published the white paper The Human Resources Situation in China on September 10, 2010. The figure is a trend chart of changes in the proportions of employed persons engaged in industries in China from 2000 to 2009, published in the white paper The Human Resources Situation in China.

<image1>

According to the trend shown in the figure, how will the proportion of employed persons in China's primary industry change in the future?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：这是2000—2009年三次产业就业人员比例变化折线图，找出图例中“第一产业就业人员比例”对应的折线。再观察该折线从2000年到2009年总体由约50%降到约40%左右，呈持续下降趋势。根据题干要求“根据图示趋势”作简单外推，判断未来第一产业就业人员所占比例将继续降低。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是我国2000—2009年三次产业就业人员比例变化折线图，纵轴为百分比，横轴为年份。图例显示“第一产业就业人员比例”对应的折线在2000年前后约为50%，之后总体向下，到2009年约降至40%左右，呈明显下降趋势。再推理：题目要求根据图示趋势判断未来变化，因此对2000—2009年的下降趋势作简单外推，可判断我国第一产业就业人员所占比例未来将继续降低。
method.CoT_answer_check_final: 先描述图像：图中是我国2000—2009年三次产业就业人员比例变化折线图，纵轴为百分比，横轴为年份。图例显示“第一产业就业人员比例”对应的折线在2000年前后约为50%，之后总体向下，到2009年约降至40%左右，呈明显下降趋势。再推理：题目要求根据图示趋势判断未来变化，因此对2000—2009年的下降趋势作简单外推，可判断我国第一产业就业人员所占比例未来将继续降低。
method.CoT_qualify_0: 推理轨迹符合要求：先描述图像再进行趋势外推；图像描述中的坐标轴、年份范围、三次产业就业比例折线及第一产业从约50%降至约40%左右的趋势均与图中信息一致；结论“未来将继续降低”与标准答案一致。无需实质修改。
method.CoT_final: 先描述图像：图中是我国2000—2009年三次产业就业人员比例变化折线图，纵轴为百分比，横轴为年份。图例显示“第一产业就业人员比例”对应的折线在2000年前后约为50%，之后总体向下，到2009年约降至40%左右，呈明显下降趋势。再推理：题目要求根据图示趋势判断未来变化，因此对2000—2009年的下降趋势作简单外推，可判断我国第一产业就业人员所占比例未来将继续降低。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Directly uses the visually observed slope of the first-industry line and projects the same trend forward; it does not rely on comparing with the other two industries except to identify the correct curve.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the line chart legend to locate the curve labeled“第一产业就业人员比例”; observe that this curve is high around 2000 and generally slopes downward through 2009, ending lower than it began.
planner_metadata.text_role: Read that the question asks about the future change of China’s first-industry employment proportion based on the shown trend.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the basic trend-extrapolation rule: if a time-series indicator shows a sustained downward trend over the observed years and the question asks according to the trend, predict continued decrease.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中三条折线分别表示第一、第二、第三产业就业人员比例，2000—2009年间第一产业曲线下行，而第二、第三产业曲线总体上升。再结合题干说明这是就业人员从事产业的比例变化趋势，运用产业结构演进规律：劳动力会由第一产业向第二、第三产业转移。因此可判断未来我国第一产业就业人员所占比例还会继续降低。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是我国2000—2009年就业人员从事第一、第二、第三产业比例变化的折线图。横轴为年份，纵轴为比例（%）。第一产业就业人员比例对应的折线从2000年前后约50%逐步下降，到2009年降至约40%；第二产业和第三产业的折线总体呈上升趋势。再推理：题目要求根据图示趋势判断未来变化。既然2000—2009年第一产业就业人员占比已经持续下行，且产业结构演进中劳动力通常由第一产业向第二、第三产业转移，所以未来我国第一产业就业人员所占比例会继续降低。
method.CoT_answer_check_final: 先描述图像：图中是我国2000—2009年就业人员从事第一、第二、第三产业比例变化的折线图。横轴为年份，纵轴为比例（%）。第一产业就业人员比例对应的折线从2000年前后约50%逐步下降，到2009年降至约40%；第二产业和第三产业的折线总体呈上升趋势。再推理：题目要求根据图示趋势判断未来变化。既然2000—2009年第一产业就业人员占比已经持续下行，且产业结构演进中劳动力通常由第一产业向第二、第三产业转移，所以未来我国第一产业就业人员所占比例会继续降低。
method.CoT_qualify_0: 候选推理符合要求：先描述图像再推理，图像中第一产业就业人员比例约由2000年的50%左右下降到2009年的40%左右，第二、第三产业总体上升，据此结合产业结构演进判断未来第一产业占比继续降低。可保留“约”以体现读图数值为估计。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Uses the structural relationship among the three industry shares plus the rise of secondary/tertiary employment to infer labor transfer away from primary industry; this route is less a single-line extrapolation and more a composition/industrialization interpretation.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read all three curves: the first-industry employment share declines over 2000—2009, while the secondary and/or tertiary industry shares show an upward tendency; the chart presents proportions of employment by industry.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text to confirm the chart concerns China’s employment proportions by industry from 2000 to 2009 and asks for the future direction of the first-industry proportion.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the geographic/economic rule that with industrialization and urbanization, labor shifts from agriculture/primary industry toward secondary and tertiary industries; since these are shares of total employment, increases in non-primary sectors correspond to a falling primary-sector share.
